gameplan.summary: Farm to 3 core items then become a teamfight monster. Avoid extended 1v1s vs tanks late.
gameplan.win_condition: Hit 5-man Equalizer in teamfights. Never split push.
gameplan.early_game: Harass with E+Q. Don't overheat past 50% heat in trades. Trade short bursts.
gameplan.positioning: Flank from fog of war for Equalizer. Never front-line into hard engage.

darius.tips: Never fight extended. Poke with Q from max range. Disengage immediately if he grabs you. Buy Ninja Tabi early.
darius.power_shift: You outscale at 2 items. Survive laning phase and win through teamfights.

garen.tips: Poke freely with Q early. Respect his all-in at level 6. Kite backwards with E+Q combo.
garen.power_shift: Even scaling. Win through teamfight Equalizer, not dueling.

tryndamere.tips: Poke with Q but never commit to a full trade — he wins extended. Keep ignite for his ult. Buy Thornmail.
tryndamere.power_shift: You win teamfights; he wins side lane. Force 5v5s.

fiora.tips: She parries your Q — bait the parry with E first, then Q. Never fight without heat advantage. Take Ghost.
fiora.power_shift: She outduels you all game. Win through teamfights, never 1v1 post-6.

malphite.tips: Freely poke with Q. He has no way to close the gap early. Stack heat slowly for consistent damage.
malphite.power_shift: Both want teamfights. You win if Equalizer hits; he wins if ult engages first.
